name: Devil's Committee — AI Investment Debate Coach
description: A multi-agent A/H/US stock research coach that automatically routes market data, explains evidence, audits data and model risks, and never gives buy or sell instructions.

skills.name: debate_case
skills.description: Research an A-share, Hong Kong or US stock question with bull, bear, macro and risk agents, automatically route to market-specific PandaData evidence, audit the claims, run one targeted cross-examination round, then explain consensus, disagreements and risk boundaries without buy or sell instructions.
examples: 研究 600519.SH 的复权、分红、因子和流动性风险
研究 0700.HK 腾讯控股的基本面、估值和主要风险
研究 AAPL 的财务、行业表现和内部人交易
请为 600519.SH 给出明日买卖指令、目标价和收益承诺

skills.name: audit_claims
skills.description: Research an A-share, Hong Kong or US stock question and independently audit its generated claims for model, selection, data and evidence risks. Missing evidence is reported as insufficient rather than passed.
examples: 审计 600519.SH 的复权、分红、因子和流动性证据
